# Mycelium Protocol by US Neural

> Decentralized, edge-native semantic routing protocol for AI agent swarms and multi-tool architectures. Replaces centralized LLM tool selection with local, sub-10ms vector-mesh discovery.

## Key Capabilities & Benchmarks
- Sub-10ms Intent Routing: Matches natural language intent to tool endpoints in <9.6ms locally using sentence-transformers (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) and ChromaDB.
- 100k Agent Scale: Tested on 100,000 synthetic agents with 70.7% Top-1 family-level accuracy (+30.3% over BM25).
- Zero LLM Inference Cost: $0 routing overhead; eliminates prompt stuffing and 2000ms LLM routing tax.
- Anthropic MCP Integration: Native Model Context Protocol adapter with Human-On-The-Loop (HOL Guard) safety firewall.
- Zero-Trust Security: Inter-agent HMAC-SHA256 message signing and Enterprise API key authorization (X-Mycelium-API-Key).
- Persistence: In-memory LRU caching with persistent SQLite backing (data/mycelium.db).

## Installation & SDKs
- Python (Backend & LangChain): `pip install mycelium-agents`
- JavaScript / TypeScript (Node.js & Web): `npm install mycelium-js`

## Core Python API Reference

```python
from mycelium.core.agent import Agent
from mycelium.integrations.langchain import MyceliumSemanticRouter

# 1. Register a capability
agent = Agent(
    agent_id="forex_01",
    name="CurrencyMaster",
    description="Converts USD, EUR, INR and provides live foreign exchange currency conversion rates.",
    tags=["finance", "currency"]
)

# 2. Semantic routing with LangChain (Sub-15ms)
router = MyceliumSemanticRouter(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1")
tool_name, score = router.route_and_execute("I need to convert 100 USD to euros", tools)
